{{Quote|I'm studying the local plants and animals from my home laboratory. Have you met my daughter Maru? She's interested to meet you.|Demetrius}}

'''Demetrius''' is a [[Villagers|villager]] who resides at [[Carpenter's Shop|24 Mountain Road]], on [[The Mountain]], with his wife [[Robin]], daughter [[Maru]], and step-son [[Sebastian]].

Demetrius is a scientist who studies the valley's local wildlife. He can often be found working in his laboratory or outdoors taking notes.

==Schedule==
After the [[Ginger Island#Beach Resort|Beach Resort]] on Ginger Island is unlocked, Demetrius may randomly spend the day there. After leaving the Island at 6pm, Demetrius will immediately go home to bed. Demetrius never visits the Resort on [[Festivals|Festival]] days or his checkup day at [[Harvey's Clinic]].

Shown below are Demetrius' schedules prioritized highest to lowest within each season. For example, if it is raining, that schedule overrides all others below it.

==Relationships==
Demetrius is married to [[Robin]] and lives with his daughter [[Maru]] and step-son [[Sebastian]]. Maru is his daughter with Robin, and Sebastian is Robin's son from an earlier relationship. It is assumed that Demetrius is Robin's second husband, because there are 2 books in the bookcase of their room titled "Maximizing Your Second Marriage" and "Practical Tips For First-Time Step-Dads." Demetrius is very protective of Maru, as shown in her two heart event.

==Events==
When your total earnings reach {{Price|25000}} Demetrius will come by your farm in the morning and tell you about some research he needs help with. He will then volunteer to improve [[The Cave]] to either attract Fruit Bats or to produce Mushrooms.

During the Summer, Demetrius will send you a letter informing you about the [[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]].

==Heart Events==
===Anytime===
At any [[friendship]] level greater than zero friendship points, you may receive a gift in the mail from Demetrius.  The chance of receiving a gift in the mail increases as your friendship with Demetrius increases.

==Quotes==
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Regular&nbsp;'''
|-
|

'''First Meeting'''
{{Squote|Greetings! I'm Demetrius, local scientist and father. Thanks for introducing yourself! I'm studying the local plants and animals from my home laboratory. Have you met my daughter Maru? She's interested to meet you.}}

'''Regular'''
{{Squote|Maru helps me out in the lab sometimes... She's a good kid.}}
{{Squote|This valley has a very vibrant and diverse ecosystem. That's one reason I was excited to move here.}}
{{Squote|You're probably growing a lot of interesting plants on your farm, huh? Maybe I'll stop by your place some day and check it out.}}
{{Squote|Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side. Don't tell her I said that.}}
{{Squote|Let's see... If compounds in the rhizosphere contain sufficient levels of Carbon-13, then... Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there. Do you need anything?}}
{{Squote|It's good to take a break from work every now and then. I guess that's kind of difficult when you live on a farm, though. Hey, at least in the winter you don't have to worry about crops.}}
{{Squote|How's the farming business going? It's [crop] season, isn't it? I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.}}

''4+ Hearts''
{{Squote|Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side. ...now if I could only quantify her mood levels, perhaps I could model the fluctuations using a sinusoidal curve...}}
{{Squote|Thanks for stopping by. I need to think about something other than legumes for a while. So, what have you been doing lately? That sounds interesting.}}

''6+ Hearts''
{{Squote|Hi [Player]! How are you doing today? I wish I could make your farming job easier somehow.}}
{{Squote|I became a scientist because I wanted to contribute to the progression of our species. Of course, none of this would be possible without farmers such as yourself.}}
{{Squote|Hi [Player]. I'm always glad when you come for a visit. It's nice to have some company after all this lonely lab-work.}}

''If Player is married to Maru''
{{Squote|It's hard to do good science without Maru's help... But her happiness is much more important than my experiment!}}
{{Squote|I hope my daughter's keeping up on her math and science!}}
{{Squote|I'm still flabbergasted about Maru's secret robot... was it all a dream?}}

''If Player incubates a dinosaur egg''
{{Squote|Say that again! Did you say you successfully incubated a dinosaur egg?! Unprecedented!}}
{{Squote|Here, take this. I'm so wound up I don't need it anymore...}} He will give the player a Triple Shot Espresso.


'''Doctor Visit'''
{{Squote|The colder season is coming up so I'm here to get my flu vaccine.}}
{{Squote|Doctor Harvey, have you read the latest 'Biology and Medicine'? There's an article I think you'd be interested in.}}

'''Summer'''
{{Squote|Sorry, I'm really busy. There's so many plants to study right now.}}
{{Squote|Make sure to water your plants every day. Although, if you're using water retaining soil you don't need to worry about watering as often. It's pretty convenient.}}
{{Squote|If you and Maru become friends, I'm sure she'll show you how to use that telescope out back. Pretty exciting, huh?}}
{{Squote|Hmm... If strigolactone levels could be increased, would it have a proportional effect on mycorhizal growth? Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there. Do you need anything?}}

'''Green Rain'''
''Year 1''
{{Squote|Don't mind me, [Player]. I'm just collecting some samples. This may be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! Erm... If you see my wife, can you tell her I'm okay?}}
''Year 2+''
{{Squote|The rain appears to be harmless, so I'm taking less precaution this year.}}

'''Fall'''
{{Squote|During this time of year I divert my attentions to fungi.}}
{{Squote|We know a lot about nature thanks to science. But there's always a lot more to learn.}}
{{Squote|How's the farming business going? It's corn season, isn't it? I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.}}
{{Squote|Maru sure spends a lot of time working on those gadgets of hers. I'm glad she's so dedicated.}}
{{Squote|Let's see... perhaps the nitrogen fixation level is affected by nematode secretions... Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there. Do you need anything?}}

'''Winter'''
{{Squote|I'm taking a break from my research right now.}}
{{Squote|Talk to my wife if you want to increase the size of your house.}}
{{Squote|Do you have a kitchen in your house yet? Cooking is kind of like doing lab work.}}
{{Squote|Do you have any animals on your farm?}}
{{Squote|Let's see... if seasonal nitrogen levels could be modeled by a piecewise function... Oh! Sorry. I was analyzing data and I didn't notice you there. Do you need anything?}}
{{Squote|Feel free to harvest as much lumber and stone from this area as you please.}}

'''If the player starts dating Maru'''
{{Squote|Yes, Maru told me the news. I can't say I'm thrilled about it, but maybe you'll prove me wrong.}}

'''If the player marries Maru'''
{{Squote|*sigh*... [Player], I've come to accept that it's time for my 'little girl' to become a woman. You have my blessing.}}

'''If the player marries Sebastian'''
{{Squote|Congratulations on the marriage. Robin's been crying since the wedding. 'Tears of joy', as she calls it! A most peculiar concept...}}
{{Squote|Hmm, now that the basement is unoccupied, I might have to expand the laboratory...}}

'''At Ginger Island'''
{{Squote|I already spotted a rare crab. This place is great.}}
{{Squote|Can you believe this place? It's teeming with exotic life!}}
{{Squote|*crunch*... whoops, there goes an endangered crab species... #Oh, nevermind. It was just the empty shell! I can sleep tonight.}}
{{Squote|Are you having fun, [Player]? You need to remember to take breaks now and then too!}}
{{Squote|I usually don't partake... but I'm usually not on a tropical island, either. Hahaha.}}
{{Squote|I'll be analyzing this data for months.}}
|}

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Crop Research|"Crop Research"]]: Demetrius will send you a letter on the 20th of [[Summer]] requesting that you bring him a [[Melon]].  The reward is {{Price|550}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*[[Quests#Aquatic Research|"Aquatic Research"]]: Demetrius will send you a letter on the 6th of [[Summer]] in year 2 requesting that you bring him a [[Pufferfish]].  The reward is {{Price|1000}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*Demetrius may request that you slay a certain number of [[Monsters]] or bring him a random item at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]].  The reward for slaying monsters varies by the number/type of monster, but is always an amount of gold.  The reward for an item delivery quest is 3x the item's base value and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*[[Quests#Aquatic Overpopulation|"Aquatic Overpopulation"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], Demetrius may randomly request that the player catch 10 season-specific fish. The reward is [[gold]] equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
*[[Quests#Biome Balance|"Biome Balance"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], Demetrius may randomly request that the player catch 20 [[:Category:River fish|River]], [[:Category:Ocean fish|Ocean]], or [[:Category:Lake fish|Lake]] fish. The reward is {{Price|1500}} and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.

==Trivia==
*If [[Robin]] is constructing something on your farm on the nights she and Demetrius go to [[The Stardrop Saloon|the saloon]], he'll go and dance by himself.
*Demetrius never mentions [[Sebastian]] in his dialogue outside of cutscenes.
*Despite Demetrius's six-heart event, [[Tomato]] is considered a vegetable crop by the game.
*If the player has successfully incubated a [[Dinosaur Egg]], speaking with Demetrius will result in him giving the player [[Triple Shot Espresso]].
